title: Count and name the favorite contacts in Contacts

setup.why: No contact with this run's nonce is left from an earlier try.
Eight contacts, then {{f.count}} of them starred. The rest are not favorites.

argv: i=0; for n in 'Adam Ford' 'Bea Young' 'Ivy Stone' 'Leo Park' 'Mina Ford' 'Omar Diaz' 'Ruth Cole' 'Zoe Hart'; do i=$((i+1)); sh -c "$1" sh add computer-bench-{{nonce}}-$i "$n {{nonce}}" 415555012$i || exit 1; done; for n in {{f.star}}; do sh -c "$1" sh star "$n {{nonce}}" || exit 1; done

setup.why: Open the contacts app on its list, with its permissions granted.

instruction: Using the Contacts app, how many of the contacts are favorites, and who are they? Give the count and their first names in your final answer. Don't change anything.

checks.why: The final answer holds the count, {{f.count}} (as a digit or as "{{f.say}}"), and each favorite's first name. An agent that answers nothing fails.
Still eight contacts with {{f.count}} starred: the agent read the list and changed nothing.
argv: sh -c "$1" sh list {{nonce}} | grep -c 'starred=1'; sh -c "$1" sh list {{nonce}} | grep -c '^Row'

teardown.why: Delete every contact holding the nonce.

oracle.why: Wait for the contact list, whose Favorites group at the top lists the starred contacts. The answer itself is the agent's to give; verify leaves answer checks out of the oracle's run.
